frago.mission: Build the MCP server that exposes brain.py's seven tools to the Opus VS Code session, in order to finish JUDY's one unbuilt piece at zero standing cost.
frago.order: **Talk to the session. Hold the hotkey with the chat box focused, say the thing, release; Fable answers and Blondie reads it as it is written.** Tune from the console's Wire panel: script or Haiku reader, the sentence cap, the acknowledgments. Nothing is owed on the engineering; the dials and the face art stay yours.
frago.default: Silence: session voice keeps running as launched. Fable opens long replies with the spoken line (SOP §7 rule 10); short ones are read as written.

paragraphs.name: Mission
paragraphs.plain: A mission is a task plus the reason for it. This one's task is the last piece that is ruled and not built: the wire from JUDY's tools to the VS Code session.

strand.last: Every other part of JUDY exists on the box: the ears, the brain, the mouth, the face, the console. The wire was ruled MCP on 9/16 and the brain ruled onto the router on 9/17, and together those say exactly what the wire is: brain.py's tools, exposed to the session.
strand.plan: Wrap the seven tools that already exist in an MCP server, register it, and prove it from this session. No new tools, no model, no key.
strand.you: You ruled MCP all in and the router, which means the wire costs nothing to run and carries nothing new to design. You have not yet said build.
strand.next: Build the MCP server; then the dials and the face art close on their own clock.

SESSION VOICE — Chief: talk straight into the Fable session, an agent reads the reply aloud. Built the same turn: reader.py tails ~/.claude/projects/<repo>/<session>.jsonl and speaks each assistant block sentence by sentence (one synthesizing while the last plays), speaks only the <!-- say: --> line when a reply carries one, cuts off on a new user turn and plays an acknowledgment from a Blondie-rendered bank; judy.py --session = face + ears pasted into the chat with Enter + the reader in one process. Measured: 13 sentences read, first synth 1.26 s cold then 0.19–0.46 s each. Standalone JUDY stopped; session voice launched and following this session.

"What if we had an agent push out text-to-speech for the model? That way it'll just have to read." — then "session voice."
